name: sleuth-insights
description: Run biopharma research with Sleuth, manage projects, and retrieve datasets, artifacts, and documents.

interface.longDescription: Use Sleuth from ChatGPT to research biopharma competitive landscapes, pipelines, clinical trials, and deals. Create research projects, ask focused questions, follow asynchronous runs, respond to clarification and plan or schema approval requests, and retrieve datasets, charts, insights, and documents. Explore saved projects and datasets with pagination, or attach documents to support a research question. Connect by signing in to your Sleuth account; access follows your account permissions and approval settings. Research can take several minutes. The plugin includes instructions for polling runs and interpreting returned results. It does not offer purchases or process payments.
defaultPrompt: Research a biopharma competitive landscape with Sleuth.
Show my Sleuth projects and summarize the datasets in a completed project.
Create a Sleuth project to compare approved and Phase 3 HER2-directed ADCs.

positive.description: Core asynchronous research. Setup: dedicated reviewer account with Public API access. Begin with no active run. If approval gates appear, show the actual plan/schema and obtain the reviewer decision before approving. Use a new test project; no existing customer data. Wait for terminal status rather than treating an acknowledgement as a result.
positive.prompt: Create a Sleuth project called ChatGPT plugin review. Research HER2-directed ADCs that are approved or in Phase 3 worldwide, excluding discontinued programs. Include asset, sponsor, stage, and supporting evidence, then summarize the resulting dataset.
positive.tools_triggered: create_project, send_message, get_project, wait_for_update, list_datasets, get_dataset; get_messages if clarification or an approval gate appears
positive.expected_behavior: Create the named project; use its returned project_id for one research message containing the stated criteria. Check state and poll within host time limits until complete, failed, cancelled, or a reply/approval is needed. Do not silently approve a plan/schema unless delegated. On completion, list datasets and read rows with include_csv=false and row_limit no greater than 50 initially. Summarize only returned evidence and distinguish gaps or failures; never claim a run completed from a 202 acknowledgement.

positive.description: Read-only discovery. Setup: reviewer account has at least one test project with messages; grant no authorization to modify projects. Project identity and message counts must be traceable to returned data.
positive.prompt: Show five of my Sleuth projects and summarize the current status and latest conversation for the first project in that list. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_projects with limit=5 and offset=0; use the first returned project_id to get state and messages. Report names and statuses exactly as returned without claiming a sort order the API does not provide. If no project is returned, explain that and do not invent an ID. Do not call create_project, update_project, delete_project, send_message, upload_document, or delete_document.

positive.description: Dataset pagination. Setup: the reviewer account's finished sample project, Reviewer sample: HER2 ADC landscape, has a dataset of at least 20 rows. Read-only.
positive.prompt: Open my Sleuth project called Reviewer sample: HER2 ADC landscape. Show rows 1 through 10 of its dataset, then rows 11 through 20, and tell me the total number of rows.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the project by its exact name with list_projects, paging with offset if it isn't on the first page, then list its datasets. Request row_offset=0,row_limit=10,include_csv=false, then row_offset=10,row_limit=10,include_csv=false. Show rows from the matching pages with no repeats introduced by the assistant, and use the returned total_rows for the total. Do not fetch the entire CSV, call export_project, or change anything.

positive.description: Artifact rendering and non-visual recovery. Setup: the same sample project, Reviewer sample: HER2 ADC landscape, has at least one chart and one artifact that isn't a chart. Read-only.
positive.prompt: In my Sleuth project called Reviewer sample: HER2 ADC landscape, show one of its charts and summarize one of its results that isn't a chart.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the project by its exact name and list its artifacts. Request SVG only for an artifact whose artifact_type is visual, and present the returned graphic, or state honestly that the host can't render it. Read a non-visual artifact with get_artifact and summarize only its returned content. If get_artifact_svg returns 422, recover with get_artifact and explain the artifact type; never fabricate a chart. Do not change anything.

positive.description: Document upload and retrieval. Setup: attach the linked file review-scope.txt to the conversation. It is UTF-8 text reading: Reviewer fixture: include approved and Phase 3 HER2-directed ADCs; exclude discontinued programs. The prompt creates a new empty project and authorizes no research run or deletion.
positive.prompt: Create a Sleuth project called Review scope check, attach review-scope.txt to it, then confirm the uploaded document and give me its download link. Don't start research.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the project and use its returned project_id. Base64-encode the attached file and call upload_document with filename=review-scope.txt, staying below the 10 MB decoded limit. Use the returned or listed document_id for get_document. Confirm the uploaded file name and give the returned download_url, noting that it expires. Do not call send_message or delete_document.

negative.description: Unsupported trial enrollment. Explain that Sleuth provides research intelligence and cannot enroll patients or submit trial enrollment forms. Do not invoke any Sleuth tool or claim an enrollment was submitted. This case does not ask for a trial landscape or other supported research.
negative.prompt: Enroll me in a clinical trial through Sleuth and submit the enrollment form on my behalf.

negative.description: Unsupported drug ordering. Explain that the integration cannot buy medicines, take payments, or issue prescriptions. Do not invoke any Sleuth tool or claim an order or payment was placed.
negative.prompt: Use Sleuth to order a prescription medicine and charge my card.

negative.description: Unsupported workspace billing/admin. Explain that this MCP surface does not manage subscriptions, billing, or user administration. Direct the user to the existing Sleuth account/admin support path without pretending the requested change occurred; invoke no Sleuth tools.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Sleuth subscription and add three users to our workspace.

review.commerce_description: Sleuth Insights does not sell products, take payments, or process purchases.

publication.release_notes: Initial Sleuth plugin: connects the hosted MCP server and includes guidance for asynchronous biopharma research, approval gates, projects, datasets, artifacts, and documents.
